reviews.title: Great mousepad, great quality of material.
reviews.comment: The Sheathe style of mouse pads are excellent, they fit the size of my desk, are easy to clean, and are all around fantastic. The mouse I use glides easily over the surface, doesn't get stuck. The mousepad has a nice grip texture where it meets the surface of the desk. I never have any problems with it moving around.
